from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
base=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689854/attempts/71aa0823e1d7415ab0ea5a5c0e56a9c6/system/state/workspace/programs')
base.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
path=base/'task-97151950.py'
code='''def transform(grid):
    # Split two aligned binary panels at a single-color full row or column.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    divider_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and grid[r][0] not in (0,)]
    divider_cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h)) and grid[0][c] not in (0,)]
    # The panel separator is a full line of a color distinct from panel colors.
    if divider_rows:
        r = divider_rows[0]
        top, bottom = grid[:r], grid[r+1:]
        n = min(len(top), len(bottom))
        return [[2 if top[i][j] != 0 and bottom[i][j] != 0 else 0 for j in range(w)] for i in range(n)]
    if divider_cols:
        c = divider_cols[0]
        left = [row[:c] for row in grid]
        right = [row[c+1:] for row in grid]
        n = min(len(left[0]), len(right[0]))
        return [[2 if left[i][j] != 0 and right[i][j] != 0 else 0 for j in range(n)] for i in range(h)]
    raise ValueError("No full-line separator found")
'''
path.write_text(code)
print(path)
